claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: U-18666A at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; its known activity is inhibition of cholesterol transport/oxidosqualene cyclase, causing lysosomal cholesterol accumulation and possibly cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress, but this is unlikely to produce broad or selective killing in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
